描述_EN: many grave goods copied objects from daily life but in reduced size, such as this figure of a camel. in the sui dynasty (581-618) daily utensils were usually made of stoneware and goods for burial were made of earthenware.
描述_ZN: 许多墓葬用品都是模仿日常生活中的物品，但尺寸较小，如这个骆驼的形象。 在隋朝（581-618），日常用具通常是由石器制成的，而埋葬的物品是由陶器制成的。
